requirements.quote: `apps/site/src/learn/`: modules (court-day practice, reading cause lists, listings and mentions, filing and defect cures, limitation basics, using the OS), MDX content with i18n (en, ta, kn).
Interactive examples built on fictional fixtures (cause lists, orders) from the existing golden fixtures; nothing from real matters.
Free signup prompts into the free alerts tier (#506)

requirements.why: apps/site is a static placeholder with no auth session or Next runtime, and progress needs a per-user table with RLS, a server action and registry entries; separate issue after the site gains a renderer.

requirements.quote: A content review workflow: every module reviewed by a practising advocate (⚖ where it touches law), with the date and reviewer shown.
At least 6 modules are live in English with Tamil and Kannada translations, each reviewed and dated.
requirements.why: Authoring 6 modules x 3 locales is delivered here, but 'reviewed and dated' needs a practising advocate's sign-off, which agents cannot give or invent; modules stay not-live until reviewer and date are filled in front matter.

requirements.quote: Module pages convert to free signups
and are tracked in the activation funnel (#509).
requirements.why: This change adds the closed 'education' channel and the tagged signup links, but recording the channel at signup (packages/auth/src/server.ts:547-552 records none for any source) is a cross-cutting auth change for all channels; separate issue.

requirements.quote: it is not legal advice, so it carries a disclaimer.

deliverables.change: Module registry (6 slugs: court-day-practice, reading-cause-lists, listings-and-mentions, filing-and-defect-cures, limitation-basics, using-the-os), loader that reads apps/site/content/learn/<slug>/<locale>.md, parses front matter (slug,title,locale,order,law,reviewer,reviewedOn) with no new dependency, exposes isLive(module) = reviewer and reviewedOn present, and review display data.

18 markdown files (6 modules x en, ta, kn); each ends with the localized disclaimer; law-touching modules set law: true (⚖); reviewer and reviewedOn left empty (never invented); examples reference fixtures by id.

Fictional cause-list and order fixtures for the examples (fictional names, 'FICTIONAL' marker, reserved/obviously fake numbers), modelled on packages/core/src/import/fixtures/bundles.ts without importing it.
signupHref(slug, locale) returning /sign-in?channel=education&module=<slug>; module is restricted to registry slugs, nothing else is carried.

Tests: 6 modules x 3 locales exist and have required front matter and disclaimer; non-live without reviewer/date; fixtures only carry the FICTIONAL marker and no real-court data patterns; every module's CTA href is the education signup link; law modules carry the flag.
Add 'education' to ACTIVATION_CHANNELS (CHECK activation_event_channel_chk follows the list).

New timestamp-named migration (pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec drizzle-kit generate; next free timestamp after the latest in migrations/meta/_journal.json) that drops and recreates activation_event_channel_chk with the new list, plus the generated snapshot and journal entry.
Add 'education' to the hard-coded ACTIVATION_CHANNELS mock at line 23.
Short doc of the review workflow: front matter fields, live rule, who reviews (practising advocate, ⚖ modules), fictional-fixture rule, disclaimer, deferred items.

preserve.what: Existing activation steps and the signed_up insert in packages/auth/src/server.ts:547-552 (unchanged)
apps/site must not gain new dependencies (package.json unchanged) and must not import @causedeck/core or @causedeck/db

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/site exec vitest run src/learn src/index.test.ts src/developer-docs.test.ts

decisions.choice: Markdown with a hand-parsed front matter instead of MDX
decisions.justification: apps/site has no Next/React/MDX dependency (apps/site/package.json:7-19) and its content precedent is plain markdown read by node:fs (apps/site/src/developer-docs.test.ts:6-9); adding MDX would be a new dependency for no rendered surface yet.

decisions.choice: Fixtures are copied in shape, not imported, from core
decisions.justification: apps/site depends only on @causedeck/config (apps/site/package.json); a workspace dependency on core would need an architecture reason, and the site must not pull DB code.

decisions.choice: New channel 'education' via migration rather than reusing 'other'
decisions.justification: The channel list is a closed enum with a CHECK (packages/db/src/schema/activation.ts:40-48,67-70) so education signups are separable in the growth page; migrations are timestamp-named per D-051 (DECISIONS.md:429-433).
